in_marathi.name: Sudershan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good or Auspicious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudershan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। He who has auspicious or good deeds. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sudh' which means pure and 'Rasana' which means having good or auspicious deeds.
